name: groot_n16
description: GROOT N1.6 VLA — nvidia/GR00T-N1.6-3B (script: run.py; config=groot, default embodiment gr1)

run_options.name: prompt
run_options.default: pick up the cup on the table
run_options.help: Natural-language task instruction for the robot policy.

run_options.name: image
run_options.help: Comma-separated RGB image paths (one per camera view).

run_options.name: num_views
run_options.help: Number of camera views (gr1 uses 1; robocasa_panda_omron and behavior_r1_pro use 3).

run_options.name: embodiment_tag
run_options.help: GROOT embodiment slot. Trained in base checkpoint: gr1, robocasa_panda_omron, behavior_r1_pro.

run_options.name: action_horizon
run_options.help: Number of action steps to generate (default 16 for quick demo; use 50 for full horizon).

run_options.name: hardware
run_options.help: FlashRT backend: auto, rtx_sm89, rtx_sm120, thor.

run_options.name: use_fp8
run_options.help: Load policy weights in FP8 when supported.
